units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 10. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office is considered adopted if at least two thirds of the established number of deputies of the representative body vote in favor.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 11. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office is signed by the chair of the representative body.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 12. When the representative body of a municipality considers and adopts a decision to remove the head of the municipality from office, the following must be ensured:
units.label: Part 12 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1) the head receives advance notice of the date and place of the relevant meeting and is given access to the appeal of the deputies or of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the draft decision of the representative body to remove the head from office;
units.label: Point 1 Part 12 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2) the head is given an opportunity to provide the deputies of the representative body with explanations concerning the circumstances advanced as grounds for removal from office.
units.label: Point 2 Part 12 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 13. A decision of the representative body of a municipality to remove the head of the municipality from office must be promulgated no later than five days after its adoption.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 14. If an initiative by deputies of the representative body of a municipality or by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation to remove the head of the municipality from office is rejected by the representative body, the matter of removal may be resubmitted to that body no earlier than two months after the meeting at which the matter was considered.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 15. A head of a municipality whom the representative body has decided to remove from office may apply to a court to challenge that decision within 10 days after its official publication.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 16. If the powers of the head of a municipality terminate early, or if a court orders procedural coercive measures against the head in the form of detention in custody or temporary suspension from office, the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall, within 10 days, appoint a person to temporarily exercise the powers of the head from among persons who, on the date of appointment, are not subject to restrictions on the right to stand for election under the legislation on basic guarantees of electoral rights and the right of citizens of the Russian Federation to participate in a referendum.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 17. If the powers of the head of a municipality terminate early, elections of a head who is elected in municipal elections are held within the time limits established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on elections and referendums.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 18. If a head of a municipality whose powers have been terminated early on the basis of a legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dismissing the head from office, or a decision of the municipal representative body removing the head from office, challenges that act or decision in court, early elections of a head who is elected in municipal elections may not be called until the court decision becomes legally effective.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 19. If the powers of the head of a municipality terminate early, the election of a head who is elected by the representative body from among its members, from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results, shall take place no later than six months after that termination of powers. If fewer than six months remain until the expiry of the representative body’s term of office, the head shall be elected from among its members at the first meeting of the newly elected representative body, whereas election from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity or by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results shall take place within three months after the representative body has been elected with a legally competent composition.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 20. If a head of a municipality whose powers have been terminated early on the basis of a legal act of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation dismissing the head from office, or a decision of the municipal representative body removing the head from office, challenges that act or decision in court, the representative body may not decide to elect a head from among its members, from among candidates presented by the highest official of the constituent entity, or from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results, until the court decision becomes legally effective.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 21. If the powers of a head of a municipality who heads the local administration terminate early, their powers as head of the local administration terminate simultaneously.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 22. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation issues a legal act dismissing the head of a municipality from office where:
units.label: Part 22 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1) the head of the municipality has issued a regulatory legal act conflicting with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the constitution (charter) or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the municipal charter, where such conflicts have been established by the relevant court and the head has failed, within two months after the court decision entered into force or within another period specified by that decision, to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision;
units.label: Point 1 Part 22 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2) the head of the municipality has committed acts, including the issue of a non-regulatory legal act, entailing a violation of human and civil rights and freedoms; a threat to the unity and territorial integrity of the Russian Federation, its national security and defense capability, or the unity of its legal and economic space; misuse of earmarked interbudgetary transfers or budget loans; or violation of the conditions for providing interbudgetary transfers or budget loans received from other budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation, where this has been established by the relevant court and the head has failed to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision.
units.label: Point 2 Part 22 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 23. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may issue a legal act dismissing the head of a municipality from office under part 22 of this Article no earlier than one month and no later than six months after the entry into force of the latest court decision necessary for issuing that legal act.
units.label: Part 23 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 24. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may dismiss from office:
units.label: Part 24 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 1) the head of a municipality if, within one month after the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation has issued a warning or reprimand to the head in accordance with part 7 of Article 29 of this Federal Law, the head has failed to take measures within their powers to eliminate the reasons that served as grounds for the warning or reprimand;
units.label: Point 1 Part 24 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 2) the head of a municipality for improper performance or non-performance of duties to ensure that local self-government bodies exercise powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life as provided for in parts 2 and 3 of Article 32 of this Federal Law, and also on the ground provided for in point 6 of part 3 of this Article, taking into account the opinion of the representative body of the municipality, no earlier than one year after the head took office;
units.label: Point 2 Part 24 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 3) the head of a municipality on one of the grounds provided for in part 3 of this Article, taking into account the opinion of the council of municipalities of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation, no earlier than two years after the head took office, if the highest official of the constituent entity has submitted initiatives to remove the head from office to the municipal representative body two or more times and that body has rejected them.
units.label: Point 3 Part 24 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 21. Early termination of the powers of the head of a municipality
units.text: 25. A head of a municipality in respect of whom the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation has issued a legal act of dismissal from office may challenge that act in court within 10 days after its official publication.
units.label: Part 25 Art. 21

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: Article 22. Local administration
units.label: Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 1. The local administration (the municipality’s executive and administrative body) is vested by the municipal charter with powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and with powers to exercise individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 2. The local administration is led by the head of the local administration on the principle of individual authority and responsibility.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 3. The head of the local administration is the head of the municipality or a person appointed to the position of head of the local administration under a contract concluded on the basis of a competition to fill that position.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 4. A head of the local administration appointed under a contract concluded on the basis of a competition holds a municipal service position.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 5. A contract with the head of the local administration is concluded for the term of office of the municipal representative body that decided to appoint the person as head of the local administration (until the day the new convocation of the representative body begins its work), but for no less than two years.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 6. The terms of the contract for the head of the local administration are approved by the municipal representative body insofar as they concern powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, and by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation insofar as they concern the exercise of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 7. If a person is appointed as head of the local administration under a contract, additional requirements for candidates for that position may be established by the municipal charter and by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 8. The procedure for conducting a competition to fill the position of head of the local administration is established by the municipal representative body.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 9. The procedure for conducting a competition to fill the position of head of the local administration must provide for publication of the competition conditions, information about its date, time and place, and the draft contract no later than 20 days before the competition date.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 10. The total number of members of the competition commission in a municipality is established by the municipal representative body.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 11. In a municipality, half of the competition commission’s members are appointed by the municipal representative body, and the other half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 12. The head of the local administration is appointed by the municipal representative body from among candidates presented by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 13. The contract with a head of the local administration exercising powers on the basis of a competition is concluded by the head of the municipality.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 14. A head of the local administration exercising powers on the basis of a competition:
units.label: Part 14 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 1) is subject to oversight by, and accountable to, the municipal representative body;
units.label: Point 1 Part 14 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 2) submits annual reports to the municipal representative body on the results of their activities and the activities of the local administration;
units.label: Point 2 Part 14 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 3) ensures that the local administration exercises powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 14 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 4) must notify the head of the municipality in writing of the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, acquisition of citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state, on the day they learn of it, but no later than five working days after the termination of Russian citizenship, acquisition of foreign citizenship (subjecthood), or receipt of a residence permit or other document referred to in this point.
units.label: Point 4 Part 14 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 15. The local administration has the rights of a legal entity.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 16. The structure of the local administration is approved by the municipal representative body upon submission by the head of the local administration.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 17. To address tasks as effectively as possible in the interests of the population residing in the relevant territory, territorial bodies of the local administration may be formed within its structure in accordance with criteria established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. That law must include, as one of the criteria for forming territorial bodies within the local administration’s structure, pedestrian accessibility enabling residents of all settlements within the municipality to travel to the municipality’s administrative center or to territorial bodies of the local administration and back within a working day.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 18. Where the structure of the local administration includes territorial bodies, expenditure on supporting their activities is provided for in the local budget separately from other expenditure, in accordance with the expenditure classification of the budgets of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 19. Sectoral (functional) bodies of the local administration may be formed within its structure.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 20. The municipal charter may, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provide for the municipal representative body’s right to participate in forming the local administration, including in approving or consenting to the appointment of deputy heads of the local administration and heads of its sectoral (functional) and/or territorial bodies, and may establish the forms and procedure for such participation.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Local administration
units.text: 21. In the temporary absence of the head of the local administration (in particular, owing to illness, leave, a business trip or other reasons), their powers are temporarily exercised by a local self-government official or an authorized municipal servant designated in accordance with the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.label: Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 1. The powers of the head of the local administration terminate early in the following cases:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 1) death;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 2) voluntary resignation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 3) release from the position held in accordance with part 2 or 3 of this Article;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 4) dismissal from office;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 5) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 6) being declared missing or dead by a court;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 7) a court judgment of conviction against the head becoming legally effective;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 8) departure from the Russian Federation for permanent residence abroad;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 9) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, or possession of citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming a citizen of the Russian Federation’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 10) conscription for military service or assignment to alternative civilian service in its place;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 11) transformation of the municipality in accordance with parts 6 and 7 of Article 12 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 12) an increase of more than 25 percent in the number of voters in the municipality;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 13) assumption of office by a head of the municipality exercising the powers of head of the local administration;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 23
